title: Ashbury Rewards Programme Terms: Points Validity, Suspension and Closure Settings
content:
These Ashbury Rewards settings, stated for every tier, govern how long points stay valid without activity, which tiers are exempt from expiry, what counts toward activity, and what closure and suspension do to points and Free Night Awards.

## Settings by tier

| Setting | Member | Silver Elite | Gold Elite | Platinum Elite | Titanium Elite | Ambassador Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Months without qualifying activity after which the whole points balance expires | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Points never expire for inactivity while the tier is held | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Points posted by the co-brand card issuer count as qualifying activity | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Any qualifying activity restarts the inactivity period for the whole balance | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Closing the account forfeits the points balance | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Closing the account forfeits unused Free Night Awards | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| While the account is suspended, points can be neither redeemed, transferred nor bought | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

The first column is the base tier, Ashbury Rewards Member.

## Clause notes

1. **Expiry period.** The inactivity period is 24 months at every tier. Members holding Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite are exempt from inactivity expiry; members at the four other tiers are not.
2. **Activity.** Co-brand card points count as qualifying activity, and any one qualifying activity restarts the period for the whole balance, not only for the points it posted.
3. **Closure.** At every tier, closing the account forfeits both the points balance and every unused Free Night Award.
4. **Suspension.** At every tier, a suspended account cannot redeem, transfer or buy points.
